# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
The purpose of this document is to bring reliability in the UI specifically with Advance Export incentive handling.

# Business Requirement
Certainly, in order to make the UI more interactive and efficient with regards to Advance Export Incentive handling.

# Scope
The Scope of these specs is to enhance the below screens:-
• Sales invoice
• Export Incentive
• Duty Script movement

# Section 2. Assumptions
• No Assumptions

# Section 3. Functional Requirement Description

# EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT
Screen 02– Shipment Plan
• Meeting Points:
Buyer orders will be created in WFX
Shipment Plan will be created in WFX consisting of Sales Order Lines where shipment is due/ planned.
Shipment plan will be created on Customer PO (WFX delivery OC) level
Multiple OCs can be clubbed under one shipment plan
Pre-Shipment Sales Invoice (PSN) will be created based on shipment Plan created in previous stage.
Shipment plan list screen will have multiple status update will be provided (PSN created, ASN Created , Sent to FA, etc.)
• Solution=> Shipment Plan
Shipment plan will be created by selecting multiple delivery OCs as per user requirement:
• Shahi Business Requirements
There should be an option to include multiple destination under one shipment plan. However, while creating ASN there should be single destination which will be selected by Logistics team.
Shipment plan once confirmed will not be changed at Sales ASN level. if needed, shipment plan has to be revised itself before usage in Sales ASN.
In case of shipment plan has been changed then system will share email alert to respective logistic person for changed shipment plan.
In case of change in shipment plan, quantities in Sales ASN should auto update as per Shahi's requirement. However, WFX will keep this auto update based on configuration where either it will be auto update or user will trigger update from Sales ASN. This update of shipment plan will be applicable only if Sales ASN is in saved or unconfirmed state. if Sales ASN is in confirmed state, shipment plan will be locked for update. If user wants to update shipment plan then Sales ASN should be revised and kept in Saved state.
Shipment Plan will also have option of Shipment tolerance % that will be driven from Buyer Master. This can be different between Shahi division.
**During plan user can take multiple destinations but will have one destination as group. Same will be auto populate in Sales ASN However it can be changed as per requirement.
• Shipment Plan Screen
Function and controls should work as stated in business requirements above.
• Shipment Plan List
Shipment Plan list will have limited columns compared to Sales ASN.
Shipment plan will have 2 status “Confirmed” or “Closed”. Confirmed will be based on shipment plan created. Status will turn to “Closed” if ASN is created against “Shipment Plan” in Confirmed mode.
Revision of Shipment will be blocked if ASN is created in confirmed mode.
In case ASN is in Saved mode, then user will be able to revise Shipment Plan. However, while confirming ASN post revision system will show alert that Shipment plan has been revised.
In case user wants to revise a shipment plan where confirmed Sales ASN has already been created then user has to cancel the ASN or revise to keep in Saved mode.
• Commercial Invoice
Commercial Invoice will be created based on Pre-shipment Export Invoice (PSN). System will have option to create PSN from
Meeting conclusion – Commercial Invoice
Meeting Points:
Pre-Shipment Sales Invoice list screen will have Shipment Plan no. for filter and tracking purpose.
Commercial Invoice (CI) will be created/ generated from Pre-Shipment Sales Invoice.
CI generated will be submitted for CHA analysis. Data of CI can be extracted to share with CHA for BOT.
Sales ANS will be created based on Pre-shipment Invoice post confirmation of Custom Booking.
Final commercial invoice will be generated from Sales ASN
ASN list will also have Shipment Plan no. for tracking
In case of re-generation of Sales ASN is required, existing Sales ASN will be cancelled, and New Sales ASN will be created by copying information from cancelled Sales ASN. This might be required in case of regeneration of E-Invoice
Solution=> Commercial Invoice
Pre-Shipment Export Invoice will used to generate commercial invoice for customer
Sales ASN will be used for Final Booking confirmation.
• Shahi Business Requirements
Multiple shipment plans are selected to generate multiple Cis. In WFX, multiple shipment plan will be selected to trigger multiple PSNs. One plan will have one PSN.
If required, user can trigger PSN from Shipment plan list where he can select multiple plans on one go. Each shipment plan will create a separate PSN.
Solution=> Tax Invoice
Sales ASN will be used to generate final commercial invoice as per booking confirmation.
Shahi Business Requirements
There will be an option on Sales ASN list to mark an ASN as "Forward to Custom” and reverse from custom". Tax invoice will be generated only if "Forward to customer" updated on Sales ASN. These tools will be user specific, only authorized user will be able to update this status.
Shipment template to be included in Sales ASN Commercial Page.
Due to any reason, if above sales ASN is not used for shipment and there is a required to regenerate Tax Invoice then there should be an option to use same ASN and CI number to create new Tax Invoice number and date. Previous Tax invoice number and date should be recorded in log with action details. New Tax invoice number will be as per existing serial used.
ASN Data field update using screen rather than revising ASN. Copy to all or next should be used on selected ASNs. Forward to Customer option will not be feasible from screen.
• Sales ASN
WFX sales ASN will be created based on PSN created in previous step. Once confirmed, sales ASN will be used to generate Tax Invoice.
In case, due to any reason Tax Invoice need to be regenerated then user will cancel the existing Sales ASN and create a new one using cancelled ASN.
Shipping Template will be values will be carried from PSN to Sales ASN.
Sales ASN List with Shipment Plan no
• Regenerate Tax Invoice
There will be a new button to regenerate Sales ASN (Tax Invoice). On click, system will cancel selected Sales ASN and recreate using same information with new Sales ASN Number. This new version will be used to regenerate Tax Invoice. Previous Sales ASN and related Tax Invoice will be available for future reference in cancelled mode.
• Update in Shipment Plan
User will not be able to change PSN and ASN quantities. These quantities will always be based on shipment plan.
In case, there will be a need to update those quantities and same will be updated in Shipment plan after cancellation or revision of Sales ASN. No need to revise PSN if Sales ASN is created.
In case Shipment plan is revised, then system will show an alert on Sales ASN list that shipment plan is revised. User will be able to update changed quantities using a button “Update Sales Order Quantities as per Shipment plan”. This option will be available only in Sales ASN is based on Shipment plan PSN Sales ASN
• LUT Master
LUT master is used to restrict shipment under LUT mode. This master works for Buyer and Ship from State, from shipment date & to shipment date.

### Screen 02 | Shipping Bill - New
Path (to be) : FA >> AR >> Shipping Bill >> New
• We need new and a comprehensive detailed screen in order to create shipping bill, keeping the record chain for all the events happening from filing the shipping bill to receiving the ICEGATE incentive acknowledgement no.
• It should be made available in the screen layout configurator
• It should be supported by Flex-field configuration
• Utility Tools :
• Save : to save this details as draft
• Confirm : to confirm the SB and generate a transaction no. at backend
• Confirm & New : to confirm and refresh the screen for new SB creation.
• Exit : Close the window and lead to SB list screen without saving any change.
• This screen would be divided into 2 segment as detailed below :-
• Header Level fields

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 12 rows · columns: Attributes (text), Description (text) · identifiers: Attributes]
| Attributes | Description |
| Customer | Customer name |
| Shipping Bill no. | It should be a alphanumeric user input field with minimum character limit of 50 alphabets |
| Shipping Bill Date | It should be date input field. It should get enabled from SB no. is filled |
| Shipping Bill Type | It will carry forward the value confirmed as Bill type while ASN confirmation |
| Shipment Type | It will carry details from incentive masters (DBK / RoSCTL / RoDTEP / FOB/ Others) |
| Port of Loading (Port code) | Name and Port code in brackets |
| Currency | Transaction currency, to be populated from ASN |
| Exchange Rate | Transaction exchange rate, to be populated from ASN |
| Invoice no. | It will auto-populated from the invoice no. from ASN, in case of multiple ASN, it will be comma separated |
| LEO No. | It should be a alphanumeric user input field with minimum character limit of 50 alphabets |
| LEO date | It should be date input field, it should get editable when LEO no. is filled |
| AD Bank details | It will enlist the customer mapped banks in the customer master |
• ASN / Invoice Details Tab

| Exchange Rate |  |
• This will be replicating the all the attributes from the logistics tab of the ASN. (advance shipment tracker screen). One invoice = one line
• It should be available in SLC to remove and increase columns as per requirement.
• Any columns enabled at the logistics details on the ASN creation.
• These values could only viewed and not editable
• Utility Tools :
• Add : it will provide a pop-up to add the confirmed Export ASN against which shipping has not been generated at the moment. It will be filtered based on Customer + Shipping Bill Type + Port of Loading + Currency + Delivery Terms
• Delete : To delete the added lines
• Incentive Tab
• It will provide a detailed OC/style/HSN level detailed view for all the selected ASNs in the ASN details tab (similar to Incentive tab on OC sales invoice screen.)
• The above highlighted segment will be displayed similarly for every incentive type Currently (DBK,RoSCTL,RoDTEP)

[TABLE 3: Table 3 · 12 rows · columns: Attributes (text), Description (text) · identifiers: Attributes]
| Attributes | Description |
| OC No. |  |
| Style |  |
| HSN Code |  |
| GDN no. |  |
| Qty |  |
| Value |  |
| Net Value |  |
| Net Value (Company Currency) |  |
| Provisional % | It will provide the incentive rate from the Incentive master for the header incentive type based on corresponding HSN |
| Provisional Amount | It will populate the the incentive amount based on the corresponding rate and Net value in company currency.
(Net value in company currency * rate %) |
| Declared % | This will be provide the user input filed to put the incentive detail submitted in the final shipping bill to custom |
| Declared Amount | This will be provide the user input filed to put the incentive detail submitted in the final shipping bill to custom |
• Summary Details : It will provide the summarize view of total incentive and valuation breakup for holistic view from single view point.
• Attachment and Remarks : It will be generic UI attachment and remarks fields
• Flex Field: It will be generic UI Flex fields master supported

### Screen 02 | Shipping Bill - List
Path (to be) : FA >> AR >> Shipping Bill >> List
• Need a comprehensive screen which will provide list level detailing for each shipping bill created
• Utility Tools (Visibility control under program permission is required) :-
• New : to navigate to SB creation screen
• Revise : to revise selected line. It cannot executed wherein the SB forwarded to accounts team
• Cancel : can the Shipping bill. It will effective only on confirmed transaction
• Delete : Delete saved lines
• Update : update line level data fields such as Shipping Bill submission date
• Log: it will show the details over changes.
• Export Shipping Bill details : it will provide the excel dump of the list screen with separated line details for incentive reconciliation details
• Import Shipping Bill. It will provide for the user to create the SB through import mechanism in specified format.
• Submit to Accounts: through this user will be able to trigger approval hierarchy on the shipping bill with variance details. (detailed below)
• This screen will provide below attributes by default, however will be flex filed supported in order to increase and columns for required information recording. It should be become part of export format

[TABLE 4: Table 4 · 23 rows · columns: Attributes (text), Description (text) · identifiers: Attributes]
| Attributes | Description |
| Status | Draft
Waiting
Confirmed
Cancelled
Closed
Submitted to Accounts (No attributes could be edited) |
| Customer |  |
| ASN no. |  |
| Shipping bill creation date |  |
| Shipping Bill no. |  |
| Shipping Bill date |  |
| Shipping Bill Type | Bill Type value (LUT/GST) |
| Shipment type | From Incentive master (DBK / RoSCTL / RoDTEP / FOB/ Others) |
| Currency |  |
| Exchange rate |  |
| Shipping Bill Amount | Total Shipping bill amount |
| Shipping Bill submission date | Editable ; Date input field (it should be editable as soon as Custom filing status updated as Filed. |
| Shipping Bill creation date | Date of shipping bill creation |
| SB Transaction no. | Internal transaction number |
| Attachments |  |
| Incentive Reconciliation | It will become accessible
It will provide collaborative view for the incentive details on multiple dimensions with provisional, declared and sanctioned incentive details in a single scree. User can input here sanctioned incentive details as per icegate. As soon as sanctioned incentive details are saved. It will system identifies that there is no variance i.e. Variance = 0, then system will update this SB status to “Submitted to Accounts” and all the invoices under that SB will start appearing for AR invoice creation. Otherwise not
if there is any variance then that particular line color will change to RED.
For the cases with Incentive Reconciliation having Variance, user would be required to push it submit to finance through the available utility tool. This approval tool should have provision through user program permission to submit to finance based on setup approval only.
When there is no variance and it has successfully updated to Submitted to accounts status, Text color will turn Green. |
| SB Version | This will store multiple version of the shipping bill with its updated values on each revision
User can identify change each revision-wise. Similar to LC Versions |
| Created By |  |
| Created On |  |
| LEO No. | Value filled on the SB creation screen |
| LEO Date | Value filled on the SB creation screen |
| EGM Date | Editable ; Date input field |
| Custom Filing Status | Draft > Filed/ Cancelled > Accepted |
• Financial impact on Shipping bill status update to “submitted to Finance”
• Incentive entry will get accounted
• DBK/RoSCTL/RoDTEP received (Recoverable) Dr.
TO DBK/RoSCTL/RoDTEP received Cr.
• There will not be any incentive booking while sales invoice posting in such case.
• Incentive details will get auto populated on the sales invoice screen based on the sanctioned incentive details attached above and will not be editable.
• As soon as incentive posting is done that particular sales invoice will start appearing
in the Duty Script movement screen for RoSCTL/RoDTEP
And on Export Incentive outstanding screen for Duty Drawback,

### Screen 03 | Non Stock Sales and Voucher posting
PATH : FA >> AR >> Non-stock Sales >> License sales
Required Changes :-

At the time of license sale invoice posting, system should check that the linked AR invoice have posted in finance or not and should trigger an Auto-Income Reversal entry from a liablity ledger to the incentive(RoSCTL/RoDTEP) income ledger, as below :-

[TABLE 5: Table 5 · 11 rows · columns: 1 (integer), ASN (text), No entry (text), Column 4 (text), Column 5 (integer)]
| 1 | ASN | No entry | Column 4 | Column 5 |
| 2 | Shipping Bill | ROSCTL (Recoverable) | Dr | 100 |
|  |  | ROSCTL | Cr | 100 |
| 3 | Licence Sale | Advance License Sale |  |  |
|  |  | Party | Dr | 50 |
|  |  | Sale of Licence | Cr | 50 |
|  |  | Reversal of Income |  |  |
|  |  | ROSCTL | Dr | 50 |
|  |  | Loss on Sale of Duty Script\ | Dr | 50 |
|  |  | ROSCTL (Recoverable) | Cr | 100 |
| 4 | Posting of Sales | Customer Account | Dr |  |
|  |  | Sale of Readymade Garment Exports | Cr |  |

### Screen 04 | Export Incentive
FA >> AR >> Export Incentive >> New
Required Changes :-
• As soon as the Shipping bill with DBK details have been successfully submitted to accounts then that particular SB will start appearing on the export incentive outstanding screen for receipt processing
• it will be of full amount, no adjustment allowed.
• No other change in the functionality

### Screen 05 | Duty Script Movement Screen
Path: FA >> AR >> Duty Script Movement
Need a provision to disable the above highlighted tabs through Screen layout Configurator.
• Applied
• Utilized
As soon as these tabs get disabled then there corresponding columns & validations will also be disabled.
From the incentive pending list the user should be directly able to directly update the :-
• Status >> license in hand
• License no.
• License value in comp currency
From the License in hand tab the transaction should directly able sent to Sold, considering its sales. Utilization details not required at Status, Utilized date, Utilized value in Company terms
**Incentive receivable value in company currency should automatically be populated in the Applied/License/Utilized/Sold Value in Company currency.
Additionally,
• a new status Is required in the status drop-down ii.e. “Ready for Utilization”
• a new column is required to attach the division name from the organization to the transaction with status “ Ready for utilization”
• “Division name” column will get enable only the transaction with Status Ready for Utilization
